name: Bistek
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical 1 lb beef bistek recipes serving 4 adults as a main dish with rice.

Total time aggregates minimum 60 min marination + active cooking steps (frying, sautéing, simmering until tender, which may require 20-30 additional minutes of covered simmering with possible water additions).
Soy sauce introduces ambiguous wheat content (many brands contain wheat; not specified as tamari or gluten-free).
Lemon classified conservatively as non-allergenic (citrus not in listed allergens).
Onions listed as '3 parts' interpreted as 3 medium onions total based on provided gram conversion.
No fish sauce, oyster sauce, or other ambiguous compound sauces present.
instructions:
0.	Marinate beef in soy sauce, lemon (or calamansi), and ground black pepper for at least 1 hour. Note: marinate overnight for best result
1.	Heat the cooking oil in a pan then pan-fry half of the onions until the texture becomes soft. Set aside
2.	Drain the marinade from the beef. Set it aside. Pan-fry the beef on the same pan where the onions were fried for 1 minute per side. Remove from the pan. Set aside
3.	Add more oil if needed. Saute garlic and remaining raw onions until onion softens.
4.	Pour the remaining marinade and water. Bring to a boil.
5.	Add beef. Cover the pan and simmer until the meat is tender. Note: Add water as needed.
6.	Season with ground black pepper and salt as needed. Top with pan-fried onions.
7.	Transfer to a serving plate. Serve hot. Share and Enjoy!

ingredients.name: Beef
ingredients.assumptions: Standard raw beef sirloin or similar cut for bistek; 1 lb converted to grams; values for typical lean-to-moderately fatty beef used in Filipino recipes.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: Regular soy sauce; 5 tbsp ≈ 75 g based on typical density of ~15 g per tbsp; common values for sodium-rich Asian-style soy sauce.

ingredients.name: Lemon
ingredients.assumptions: Juice and some pulp from 1 medium lemon (edible portion after squeezing; ~58 g juice/pulp yield); standard lemon nutrition.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 3 average garlic cloves ≈ 9 g total; raw garlic values.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 3 medium onions total (≈100 g each raw, peeled/edible portion); split between frying and sautéing per instructions; standard yellow onion nutrition.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Olive oil; 4 tbsp ≈ 54 g (standard 13.5 g per tbsp); pure oil values, including for any 'as needed' frying.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.assumptions: 1 cup water = 237 g; plain water contributes zero macros.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.assumptions: 1 pinch table salt ≈ 0.3 g; negligible contribution to macros, treated as zero.
